company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform for building and using APIs, simplifying each step of the API lifecycle. It provides an elegant, flexible environment to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services, streamlining collaboration for engineers and enterprises.
target_audience: Engineers, individual developers, and teams within organizations of all sizes, from startups to enterprises, who are involved in building, testing, managing, and distributing APIs.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service platform that provides a Postgres database along with tools for authentication, data APIs, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings. It serves as a complete Postgres developer platform, enabling users to build and scale applications from prototypes to production.
target_audience: Supabase is built for developers, innovation teams, citizen developers, engineers, and non-technical consultants. It caters to individuals, teams, startups, and enterprises looking to build and scale applications, particularly those leveraging AI, by providing a production-ready backend infrastructure.

company_overview: Vapi provides a unified, API-native platform for building, testing, and deploying AI voice agents at scale. The platform handles infrastructure, orchestration, real-time monitoring, and integrations, offering enterprise-grade configurability and compliance.
target_audience: Vapi targets developers and early teams, as well as scaling teams and sophisticated organizations, including Fortune 100 companies, that need to deploy and manage AI voice agents. Its solutions are designed for enterprises and sales teams seeking to automate and enhance customer interactions and reporting.
team_members: Jason Mitura: VP of Software Development
